description: 桃園國際機場電動車充電站基本資料 [airports and electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 桃園國際機場股份有限公司. 本資料集彙整桃園國際機場內所有電動車充電站的基本資訊，涵蓋站點位置、可供使用的充電樁數量、功率等規格與營運時間。 民眾與業者可利用此資料規劃充電路徑、評估設施覆蓋率，或結合即時車流資訊提升旅客停車與充電效率。 資料每月更新，確保使用者取得最新的充電站可用性與服務資訊。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 桃園國際機場股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
